title: contingency-plan
description: Left-right split composition: vertical flow of numbered nodes on the left, detail panel on the right. Each node activates in sequence. Suitable for risk registers, contingency flows, or any 2–6 item process with numbered labels and body text.

nodes.description: JSON-encoded array of node objects. Each: { id (string, e.g. '01'), label (string), desc (string) }. Supports 2–6 nodes.

activeNode.description: Zero-based index of the node active at composition start

primaryColor.description: Inactive node circle colour, title colour, info heading colour. Should match the base plate.

accentColor.description: Active node circle colour. Use a contrasting ACS plate colour.

durationPerNode.description: Seconds each node is displayed. Total = nodes.length × durationPerNode + 1s hold.
